Decide the wrapping mechanism first (structured DDL via the existing ClickHouseDDLGenerator.generate_column_list vs corrected regex post-processing), implement key-aware wrapping, fix the generator manifest AND resolver, then prove with unit tests plus the three live cells (vector_search, datavault, tpcds).
description:
2026-07-21 adversarial UAT review finding (P0): the remediation that made ClickHouse vector_search and datavault SF=0.01 pass live exists ONLY as unmerged local commit 5f266e76f on branch fix/uat-clickhouse-loader-nullability-dialect (no remote, no PR). origin/develop@9f69c53c6 still loses all nullability: _optimize_table_definition (benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/workload.py:70-154) never adds Nullable(...), so bare DuckDB types from schema_primitives.py:52-56 reach ClickHouse as NOT NULL while the value converter correctly emits None (data_loading.py:2148-2203) -> live failures 'NoneType has no attribute year/tzinfo' (TPC-DS date/DataVault load_end_dts) and integer None rejection.

The stranded commit is NOT mergeable as-is; four defects found by review:
1. Wraps Nullable onto tuning-key columns: 9 tuned TPC-DS tables (STORE_SALES SS_SOLD_DATE_SK partition + SS_CUSTOMER_SK/SS_STORE_SK/SS_PROMO_SK sorting, STORE_RETURNS, CATALOG_SALES, CATALOG_RETURNS, WEB_SALES, WEB_RETURNS, DATE_DIM, ITEM, CUSTOMER per tpcds_tuned.yaml) get Nullable columns in MergeTree ORDER BY/PARTITION BY; allow_nullable_key appears nowhere in benchbox/ -> schema-creation crash replaces the load crash.
2. Greedy regex \([^;\n]*\) corrupts compact single-line DDL when a paren-typed nullable column is not last (b Nullable(DECIMAL(10,2), c VARCHAR(5))); its own test only covers last position.
3. Nullable(X) NOT NULL can be emitted if get_schema() nullability disagrees with rendered DDL (strip runs before wrap).
4. A nullable FLOAT[N] would become Nullable(Array(...)), which ClickHouse rejects (latent).

Same review, dialect side (P1, fully live on develop): resolve_csv_dialect's manifest branch is all-or-nothing (data_loading.py:189-197) -- partial metadata (vector_search writes only csv_has_header, generator.py:206) falls back to comma for .csv, discarding the benchmark's _csv_delimiter='|' (benchmark.py:94-95) -> embedding fields split on commas. 15+ platforms share the resolver. Correct fix is BOTH generator-side (self-describing manifest) and resolver-side (field-by-field fallback per the documented a->b->c precedence). 5f266e76f only fixes the resolver.

Also falsify/close during live verification: chdb/clickhouse-local file() path may silently coerce empty nullable fields to 0/epoch/'' via input_format_csv_empty_as_default (data_loading.py:2041-2059) -- corruption, not crash.

This item is the remaining implementation chunk of [[uat-clickhouse-server-loader-type-coverage]]; that umbrella's live TPC-DS closure is checkpoint w6/v4 here.

anti_patterns.dont: fabricate default values for genuinely nullable fields anywhere in the load path
anti_patterns.instead: preserve None end-to-end and make the DDL accept it
anti_patterns.why: silent corruption is worse than the current loud failure; None-preservation is tested behavior

anti_patterns.dont: fix only the resolver and leave the vector_search manifest partial
anti_patterns.instead: fix generator-side metadata AND the resolver fallback
anti_patterns.why: the data artifact should be self-describing; every downstream consumer of the manifest inherits the ambiguity otherwise

anti_patterns.instead: rework it; treat the branch as superseded prior art
anti_patterns.why: the commit corrupts compact DDL (greedy paren regex), breaks tuned TPC-DS, and its tests only cover last-position paren types

anti_patterns.dont: wrap Nullable onto ORDER BY/PARTITION BY/PRIMARY KEY columns without an explicit allow_nullable_key decision
anti_patterns.instead: exclude resolved key columns from wrapping, or set allow_nullable_key=1 deliberately with recorded rationale
anti_patterns.why: ClickHouse rejects Nullable key columns; tuned TPC-DS has 9 tables with nullable columns in tuning keys, so blind wrapping turns a load-time crash into a schema-creation crash

preserves.behavior: All 99 existing tests in test_clickhouse_adapter.py + test_csv_dialect.py stay green.
Non-nullable columns keep bare types + NOT NULL semantics; tuned and baseline ClickHouse DDL for them is byte-identical to today.
The converter's None-preservation contract (test_clickhouse_adapter.py:637-653): no fabricated 0/epoch/'' defaults anywhere.
Tuned TPC-DS CREATE TABLE succeeds for all 24 tables (the 9 key-affected tables are the regression surface).
clickhouse-local keeps the faster file() load path; the client-insert path stays gated to server deployment mode.

work_units.summary: Re-validate the review evidence before starting: 5f266e76f still unmerged, develop DDL still bare-typed, resolver still all-or-nothing

work_units.evidence: Decision: use key-aware, parenthesis-aware post-processing of the existing DuckDB DDL, not full structured regeneration and not the stranded greedy regex. Evidence across TPC-DS dict/list schemas, DataVault object schemas, vector_search list schemas, and NYC/TSBS dict-of-columns schemas shows no uniform ColumnDefinition input seam. create_schema intentionally requests DuckDB DDL to retain PKs, while replacing it with ClickHouseDDLGenerator would re-render every column and violate byte-identical non-nullable DDL. A local top-level column scanner can wrap only source-nullable, non-key type spans, preserve all other bytes, and correctly keep mid-list DECIMAL(10,2) boundaries.
work_units.notes: Structured path is preferred if reachable from the workload mixin without breaking the ADR-3 single-renderer contract.
work_units.summary: Decide wrapping mechanism: extend structured DDL (tuning/generators/clickhouse.py generate_column_list already emits Nullable) vs corrected regex post-processing; record decision + rationale in the PR

work_units.evidence: Nullable wrapping excludes source PK metadata plus resolved PRIMARY KEY/PARTITION BY/ORDER BY references. Tuning identifiers are normalized to actual DDL case. Real chDB created all 24 TPC-DS business tables plus dbgen_version; focused suite 99/99 and tuned gate 1/1 pass.
work_units.summary: Key-aware Nullable wrapping: never wrap columns present in resolved ORDER BY/PARTITION BY/PRIMARY KEY, or set allow_nullable_key=1 deliberately with recorded rationale; cover all 9 tuned TPC-DS tables

work_units.evidence: Parenthesis-aware top-level column scanning preserves compact mid-list DECIMAL(10,2) boundaries; selected type-span edits leave other bytes untouched. Contradictory source-nullable plus NOT NULL raises ValueError, and pre-existing Nullable types are not double-wrapped.
work_units.summary: Fix compact-DDL handling (greedy paren regex) with a mid-list DECIMAL(10,2) regression test; guard the Nullable(X) NOT NULL invariant (raise or strip, never emit)
